🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high：high
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 open_：open
  4. 计算 close：close
  5. 计算 eps：np.finfo(float).eps
  6. 计算 safe_close：close.clip(lower=eps)
  7. 计算 bar_range：(high - low)
  8. 计算 wick_base：np.minimum(open_, close)
  9. 计算 lower_wick：((wick_base - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  10. 计算 close_location：((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  11. 计算 absorption：(lower_wick * close_location).滚动窗口(16, min_periods=16).mean()
  12. 计算 high_water：safe_close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max().clip(lower=eps)
  13. 计算 depth：(1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0)
  14. 计算 prior_close：safe_close.shift(1)
  15. 计算 downside_damage：(-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0).滚动窗口(12, min_periods=12).sum()
  16. 计算 ret：safe_close.pct_change()
  17. 计算 downside_energy：ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  18. 计算 total_energy：ret.pow(2).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  19. 计算 downside_share：(downside_energy / total_energy).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  20. 计算 signal：depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage)
  21. 计算 signal：signal * (1.0 - 0.5 * downside_share)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smoothed_60(df): """Measure underwater lower-wick absorption with a slower drawdown reference ">class="kw">for robust predictive ordering.""" df_copy = df.copy() high = df_copy["high"] low = df_copy["low"] open_ = df_copy["open"] close = df_copy["close"] eps = np.finfo(float).eps safe_close = close.clip(lower=eps) bar_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan) wick_base = np.minimum(open_, close) lower_wick = ((wick_base - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) close_location = ((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) absorption = (lower_wick * close_location).rolling(16, min_periods=16).mean() high_water = safe_close.rolling(60, min_periods=60).max().clip(lower=eps) depth = (1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0) prior_close = safe_close.shift(1) downside_damage = (-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0).rolling(12, min_periods=12).sum() ret = safe_close.pct_change() downside_energy = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() total_energy = ret.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan) downside_share = (downside_energy / total_energy).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) signal = depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage) signal = signal * (1.0 - 0.5 * downside_share) df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smoothed_60"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smoothed_60"]
